Maintenance Notes

Data limitations

Uptime and MTBF require actual equipment operating time and failure records. They are not estimated here. Labor and downtime include tracked sessions plus manual entries. Manual hours from older records are attributed to the work order date; timers and movements have exact timestamps. Rates are configured estimates. Received purchasing costs are separate from repair costs. Data stays in this browser until the backend is connected.
